title: The dead machine left four mana
era: 1994 artifact strategy illustrated using current mana-pool rules
story: During my main phase my opponent used Disenchant on Su-Chi , my 4/4 artifact creature. Su-Chi went to the graveyard, and its triggered ability put four colorless mana into my pool after resolving. When the stack was empty, I spent those four mana to cast Juggernaut . I had not received that mana when Su-Chi first entered the battlefield; the payout came only when it died. The sequence uses modern mana rules. At a historical 1994 table, leaving the mana unspent until the phase ended could instead have meant mana burn.
review: Opponent casts Disenchant (instant) on my Su-Chi artifact creature during my main phase; after it dies, its death trigger adds four colorless. Stack empties, I may cast Juggernaut during own main phase with four mana. 1994 mana burn contrasted with modern rules; curated example not registered match.
